rows.subject: regional_sales
rows.question: 2026年6月我权限范围内各渠道的净销售额是多少？用订单行实付减退款，退款归原支付月份，返回渠道名和金额。
rows.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset matched independent Python arithmetic
rows.sql: SELECT "c"."channel_name" AS "渠道名", SUM("oi"."amount" - COALESCE("r"."refund_amount", 0)) AS "净销售额" FROM "fact_order_item" AS "oi" JOIN "fact_order" AS "o" ON "oi"."order_id" = "o"."order_id" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "c" ON "o"."channel_id" = "c"."channel_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "refund_amount" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "r" ON "oi"."item_id" = "r"."item_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "c"."channel_name" ORDER BY "渠道名" LIMIT 1001

rows.subject: global_analyst
rows.question: 2026年6月售出的各产品型号，观察满30天后，30天激活率各是多少？列出型号、售出设备分母、按时激活设备分子、百分数，未激活和晚激活均保留在分母。
rows.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset matched independent Python arithmetic
rows.sql: WITH "sold_devices" AS (SELECT "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", "o"."paid_date" AS "paid_date", "p"."product_name" AS "product_name" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "oi" ON "o"."order_id" = "oi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "b" ON "oi"."item_id" = "b"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "p" ON "d"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "activation_events" AS (SELECT "fact_device_activation"."device_id" AS "device_id", "fact_device_activation"."activation_date" AS "activation_date" FROM "fact_device_activation" AS "fact_device_activation") SELECT "sd"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "ae"."activation_date" IS NULL AND "ae"."activation_date" >= "sd"."paid_date" AND "ae"."activation_date" <= "sd"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN "sd"."device_id" END) AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "ae"."activation_date" IS NULL AND "ae"."activation_date" >= "sd"."paid_date" AND "ae"."activation_date" <= "sd"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN "sd"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "sd"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "sold_devices" AS "sd" LEFT JOIN "activation_events" AS "ae" ON "sd"."device_id" = "ae"."device_id" GROUP BY "sd"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.subject: global_analyst
rows.question: 2026年6月售出设备按型号看30天售后设备率。仅取已观察满30天的批次，含退款设备，同一台多次报修只记一台；返回型号、设备分母、售后设备分子和百分数。
rows.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_name" AS "型号", COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id") AS "设备分母", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "fst"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "fst"."device_id" END) AS "售后设备分子", ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "fst"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "fst"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id"), 2) AS "百分数" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bod" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bod"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bod"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" LEFT JOIN "fact_service_ticket" AS "fst" ON "bod"."device_id" = "fst"."device_id" AND "fst"."created_date" <= "fo"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= '2026-06-01' AND "fo"."paid_date" <= '2026-06-30' AND "fo"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "dp"."product_name" ORDER BY "型号" LIMIT 1001
